decks.summary: Guide Gloria who reads the encounter deck with Alyssa Graham, Scrying and Foresight to bury its worst cards, investigates with Read the Signs, and digs with Astronomical Atlas.
True solo level 0 Gloria who throws enemies out of the encounter deck with Alyssa Graham and Scroll of Secrets before they arrive, fighting with Shrivelling and Spectral Razor when one slips through.
Jailor Gloria for three or more players who locks up to seven enemies away beneath her, in Binder's Jars and the victory display via Blood of K'n-yan, with Eye of Ghatanothoa to dodge her weakness.
Waking-side Dream-Eaters Gloria built beside a Yorick, weeding the encounter deck with Alyssa Graham and Scroll of Secrets, investigating with Read the Signs and fighting with Sword Cane.
A solo first constructed Gloria for Dunwich, pairing Shrivelling and Spectral Razor with Seeker clues, and Alyssa Graham, Scrying and Scroll of Secrets to manage the encounter deck.
Punk Rock Grandma: a hipster solo Gloria with the full ten Rogue cards, from "Watch this!" and Quick Thinking to Think on Your Feet, around Alyssa Graham, Sword Cane and Shrivelling.
Spanish-podcast level 0 Gloria with a Guardian splash of First Watch, Stand Together, "Let me handle this!" and Self-Sacrifice, plus Scrying, Sixth Sense and Sword Cane.
Dynamic Duo Gloria built to pair with a Mind's Eye Norman Withers, massaging the encounter deck with Alyssa Graham and Scroll of Secrets while Sixth Sense and Shrivelling do the work.
Heavy Reading Gloria who fights with "Throw the Book at Them!" and slings spells from her hand through True Magick, sniping with Enchanted Bow and boosted by Cat Mask.
Level 0 encounter-control Gloria who peeks every turn with Alyssa Graham and Scroll of Secrets, investigating with Clairvoyance and Rite of Seeking and fighting with Shrivelling.
